faq.q: What do I get by using the referral link?
faq.a: When you order a new Tesla Model 3 or Model Y through the referral link, you get 1,000 km of free Supercharging. The kilometres are added to your Tesla account automatically after delivery.

faq.q: Can I add the referral link after I have ordered?
faq.a: No. The order has to be placed through the referral link. Open the link first and complete the order in the same session.

faq.q: Does using the referral link cost anything extra?
faq.a: No. The price of the car is the same. You simply get free Supercharging on top.

faq.q: Does the referral link work for Model S, Model X or used cars?
faq.a: No. The benefit currently applies only to new Model 3 and Model Y ordered from Tesla.

faq.q: Does the referral link work in my country?
faq.a: The link works in the countries where Tesla's referral program is active. Choose your country on tesla.com. The benefit can vary by country, and the configurator shows it before you place the order.

faq.q: Is this an official Tesla site?
faq.a: No, this is a private site made by a Tesla owner. The link itself goes to Tesla's official referral program on tesla.com, and Tesla's terms apply. Tesla may change the benefits at any time.
